Auto Rental Collision Damage Waiver
Rent an eligible vehicle with your credit card and you can be covered for damage due to collision or theft.11
Book when the time’s right
Redeem your miles for travel with no blackout dates or seat restrictions.
Book with Capital One Travel
Earn unlimited 5X miles on hotels, vacation rentals and rental car bookings. Plus, save an average of 15% on flights with price prediction from Capital One Travel.12
Elevate your stays
Receive a $50 experience credit with every Lifestyle Collection booking to use toward things like dining, spa treatments or other activities unique to each stay.4
Get 24-hour travel assistance
If your credit card is lost or stolen, you can get an emergency replacement card and a cash advance.
Get Hertz Five Star® status
Get free status upgrades, skip the line and choose from a wider selection of rental cars.7
Get up to a $120 credit
Receive up to a $120 credit for Global Entry or TSA PreCheck®.6
No foreign transaction fees
You won’t pay transaction fees when making purchases outside of the United States.
Travel with accident insurance
Get automatic insurance for a covered loss at no extra charge when you use your credit card to purchase your fare.11
Rewards redemption
Book a trip
Whether you want to explore the world or enjoy a staycation, Capital One Travel can help. Use your miles to book flights, make hotel reservations and more.
Get reimbursed
Redeem miles to cover travel purchases made with your Venture Rewards card within 90 days of the purchase date.
Redeem for cash
Cash in your miles for a statement credit or a check.2
Redeem for gift cards
Redeem rewards for gift cards with your favorite merchants.3
Redeem rewards with ease
Sign in to your account or use Capital One’s mobile app to easily view redemption options.
Redeem rewards with PayPal
Use your Capital One rewards on eligible purchases at millions of online stores.13
Redemptions big and small
Use miles as you go, or save up for a big trip or purchase.
Shop at Amazon.com
You can pay for Amazon.com purchases using your Capital One rewards.14
Transfer your miles
Transfer your miles to your choice of 15+ travel loyalty programs for more flexibility.
Unlimited rewards that don’t expire
There’s no limit to the amount of miles you can earn with the Venture Rewards credit card. Plus, your rewards won’t expire for the life of the account.
Shopping
Access Capital One Offers
Cardholders have exclusive access to earn statement credits or rewards by shopping online at thousands of retailers, like Adidas, Macy’s and more.
Enjoy an extended warranty
You’ll get additional warranty protection at no charge on eligible items that are purchased with your credit card.11
Save with Capital One Shopping
This free browser extension automatically applies the best available coupon codes at checkout and alerts you when prices drop on items you’ve viewed or purchased. Capital One Shopping is free for everyone, whether or not you have a Capital One credit card.
Events & exclusives
Access exclusive events
Enjoy 5X miles on Capital One Entertainment purchases and access to can’t-miss events across music, sports, dining, theater and more with a collection of VIP packages, exclusive pre-sales, tickets and onsite perks. Explore Capital One Entertainment.8
Get 50% off handcrafted beverages
Capital One cardholders enjoy 50% off all handcrafted beverages every day at any Capital One Café nationwide. Find your Café.15
Account management
Add an authorized user
Add an authorized user to your account and track spending by user.
Chat with Eno
Chat with Eno, your Capital One assistant, over text, online or in the Mobile app for quick answers to your account questions.16
Choose your due date
Pick your own monthly due date and payment method—check, online or at a local branch—all with no fee.
Get 24/7 customer service
Helpful customer service representatives are available to assist you 24 hours a day.
Get tip alerts
Eno can let you know if it spots a higher-than-usual tip on your account.16
Monitor your credit for free
Use CreditWise from Capital One to check your FICO® Score 8 as often as you’d like and get alerts when your TransUnion® or Experian® credit report changes.17
Help never miss a payment
Set up AutoPay for your account and your payments will be made automatically every month.
Receive account alerts
Receive an alert if Capital One detects a potential mistake or unexpected charge, like a duplicate purchase or a sudden recurring bill increase. Track recurring merchants and other frequently used merchants where your card is stored online.1618
Sign in with Sureswipe / Touch ID
Sign in to Capital One Mobile quickly and securely with your fingerprint or customized pattern.
Stay on top of your account
Manage your account anywhere, anytime, with the Capital One Mobile app. Pay your bill, view your balance and transactions—even stay on top of your credit for free with CreditWise from Capital One.17
Transfer a balance
Transfer your higher-rate balances onto a Capital One card.19
Security features
Get $0 fraud liability
If your card is lost or stolen, you will not be responsible for unauthorized charges.20
Get security alerts
Get notified via text, email and phone if Capital One notices potential suspicious transactions on your account.
Lock your card
Lock your card in the Capital One Mobile app if it’s misplaced, lost or stolen.21
Replace your card
If your card is lost or stolen, you can get an emergency replacement and a cash advance.
Use virtual cards
Pay for online purchases with virtual cards and keep your physical card number to yourself.18
